commentary.text: 90+15' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+13' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
90+12' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes it short.
90+12' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Augusto Batalla easily deals with the threat.
90+10' 2 - 1 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Augusto Batalla into the bottom left corner.

90+9' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+8' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) trips an opposition player and Isidro Diaz signals a foul. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Real Madrid.

90+5' What a wasted opportunity by Rodrygo (Real Madrid)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Augusto Batalla makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
90+5' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
